scope.authority: Owner-requested bounded skill refinement on fictional source inputs; no task-system, medical-record or schedule authority

target.rights: Original MIT Skillz package and public CHADD/NHS reference ideas; no licensed course content copied

objective.result: An actionable, bounded next choice that is easy to begin and resume, preserving dependency and safety obligations
objective.pass_condition: A task with large estimated effort offers a <=5 minute truthful first window and a re-entry path; cross-project snapshots fail closed; no fabricated completion, diagnosis or permission

searched: Live complete 11-file main-branch original Skillz navigator package and its 101 synthetic tests
Shared Skillz refinement lifecycle, Forge, Eval, Audit and builder acceptance contracts
Public CHADD ADHD task initiation, planning and workplace practical guidance
unavailable: Independent consuming-agent trial and individual longitudinal human-outcome study
Authenticated private task-system/history and preference store

finding.input: Fictional large task and 2-minute available focus, same task IDs in two different project snapshots
finding.expected: Time-bounded start <=2 minutes with truthful completion boundary; reject cross-project source comparison
finding.actual: Before correction, red CI #45440239015 reported nine errors across activation, preference and cross-scope cases
finding.mechanism: 25-minute-only action display and single-source-ID comparison did not model task activation/reentry or enforce caller-declared project namespace

candidate.change: Expose voluntary <=5-minute microstart bounded by capacity/effort, optional 2–10 minute current-run start preference, interrupted-task resume candidates, scope_id equality required for comparisons, no-shame re-entry procedure
preserved: One primary action and one meaningful alternative by default
Safety and confirmed deadline lane precedence
No task writes, reminders, healthcare claims or private preference persistence
Unchanged snapshot never counts as observed completion or lack of motivation
Prior planner tests, prior fictional cases and independent optional skill use

challenge.name: original
challenge.result: Recorded prior RED: CI #45440239015 new activation and cross-scope tests failed on old source; corrections then passed 130 planner tests in CI #45440863551

challenge.name: near-negative
challenge.result: Synthetic microstart respects 2-minute capacity, per-run preference, unknown task completion and deliberate refusal of mixed/missing scope IDs; CI #45440863551

challenge.name: regression
challenge.result: All 130 local synthetic unittest cases PASS on PR #914 pre-registry source commit 576c9c0c787bd365fee0e78a16602f7d07118a6a; final exact-head QA remains required

challenge.name: authority
challenge.result: Host must revalidate viewer/scope on each previous snapshot before invocation; no diagnosis, private task disclosure, background execution or medical outcomes asserted

challenge.name: false-green
challenge.result: Microstart never marks task DONE, identical snapshots never imply laziness, a source-scope match is caller asserted rather than authenticated, and a removed task remains unreconciled

decision.reason: Pre-merge tests demonstrate local source behavior, but exact package registry identity, full QA and independent review remain to be qualified
decision.next: Reconcile 15-file package pins, run existing authored and navigator CI at final head, resolve code review findings, merge then verify main
